conventions.convention: The odd marked action is the right action z·X = z wedge Z_p. The mod-2 comparison retains X: the common coefficient ring is F₂[X]/(X²), obtained from the Bar–Natan ring by quotienting by (2,h).
Odd invariance and sign comparison use the full prescribed face products, including zero-composite faces. The comparison does not assert equivalence for every merely square-compatible assignment.

Lee coefficients are rational, X² = 1, deg(1) = 1 and deg(X) = −1. The decreasing filtration F^p is spanned by terms of quantum degree at least p; differential terms change quantum degree by 0 or +4. The empty diagram has the single term Q in degrees (0,0).

The spectral-sequence proof calls the associated-graded complex E₁ and its Khovanov cohomology E₂. Canonical labels are a = 1+X and b = X−1; a Seifert circle receives a exactly when nesting parity plus counterclockwise-orientation indicator is even.
For a nonzero Lee homology class, its level is max{p : x ∈ F^p}. The two extremal knot levels differ by two, and s = s_max−1 = s_min+1.

Geometric invariance and movie claims retain countable choice. Knot cobordisms are smooth proper embedded oriented surfaces in S³×I with product end collars; the genus inequality assumes connectedness. Movie existence alone supplies no movie-independence theorem.

The Whitehead witness uses the positive clasp and Hedden–Ording parameter t = 2: one negative full annulus twist is added to the positive trefoil's blackboard framing +3. The Floer computation retains positive-X rectangles and accounts for the extra basepoint factors.

The refined LEO computation counts are a dated source report, not a present census or an independently repeated knot-by-knot computation. The reported counts agree with §7.1 of https://arxiv.org/html/2312.09114v3.

load_bearing.statement: The bounded spectral sequence has rational Khovanov cohomology on its homology page and converges to the associated graded of Lee homology. The 2^c canonical orientation cycles form a basis. For a knot, the canonical classes have equal lower filtration level, and the two quantum-congruence homology lines have levels differing by two.

The full prescribed odd face products, including zero-composite faces, admit integral edge signs; two realizations are related by vertexwise signs commuting with the marked right action. The construction is finite and choice-free.

A supplied finite protected marked movie admits integral marked-module odd and Bar–Natan maps with common reduction and quantum degree its Euler characteristic. A connected knot concordance induces a localized Bar–Natan chain homotopy equivalence; a localized knot complex retracts onto one free rank-one module in cohomological degree zero and odd quantum parity.

Under countable choice, based knot diagrams yield odd/Bar–Natan LEO triples, based diagram changes preserve the complexes up to marked chain homotopy equivalence, and pointed connected sums give tensor products over the marked rings with quantum shift {−1}.

Under countable choice, a connected compact smooth oriented properly embedded genus-g surface between knots in S³×I, with product collars, gives a rational Lee homology isomorphism of filtered degree −2g; consequently |s(K₁)−s(K₀)| ≤ 2g.

Under countable choice, a connected smooth proper genus-g spanning surface can be modified by an orientation-preserving ambient diffeomorphism fixed near the outer boundary to meet a concentric round inner ball in a flat disk. Removing that ball gives a connected collared knot-to-unknot cobordism of genus g and Euler characteristic −2g in the explicit round shell.

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. The positive-clasped Whitehead double D_+(T₂,₃,2), with Hedden–Ording parameter t = 2, satisfies τ = 0 and s = 2. Read-only recomputation verified the 986 grid moves, both full filtered quotient matrices and H₀ vanishings, and the supplying Khovanov calculation's four ranks.

seams_checked.note: Supplier definitions and actual consumer uses agree on smooth proper embedded surfaces, orientations, product collars and countable choice. The LEO theorem uses the smooth concordance-group clause.
The normalized cube, crossing shifts, signed cancellation models and marked actions match their Lee/odd consumers. Lee associated-graded and local-cancellation uses preserve the supplier conventions.

The Whitehead proof uses the full filtered grid differential, normalized Alexander and Maslov origins, explicit basepoint factors, and distinct conjugation and reverse-mirror duality. The comparison supplier's proof supplies the specialization used.

The Carter–Saito theorem and Khovanov movie-map definition use the supplied generic-movie and collar conventions. Their movie-independence claims invoke separate suppliers rather than attributing independence to this batch's movie definition.

The Lee computation uses the stated rational operations, quantum changes and s-level convention. The nonsliceness theorem applies the smooth four-ball bound to an actual smooth slice disk under countable choice.
